description: React component for displaying activity logs of user sessions, including device info, last activity time, and session revocation functionality.

classes.name: ActivityLog
classes.description: React component class for rendering individual user session activity logs.

methods.name: handleMoreInfo
methods.description: Sets state to show more info about the session.

methods.name: submitRevoke
methods.description: Calls parent function to revoke the session.

methods.name: isMobileSession
methods.description: Determines if the session is from a mobile device based on device_id.

methods.name: sessionInfo
methods.description: Generates device icon and title based on session properties.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the activity log UI including device info, last activity, and revoke button.
